text: This report outlines the parking by-law amendments required to implement one (1) Electric Vehicle (EV) charging location on Prince Arthur Avenue, for the roll out of two (2) charging stations for which this Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This location has been reviewed and supported by the local Councillor.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Deferred consideration of the Item until the May 28, 2026 meeting of Toronto and East York Community Council.
